---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or capability for Portalis
title: '[FEAT] <Short Description>'
labels: 'type:feature'
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem you are trying to solve or what limitation you encountered. (e.g., "When the Wi-Fi briefly disconnects, the agent terminates completely.")

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen. What component should change? What is the expected behavior?

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Architectural Scope & Compatibility
- Does this affect the frame protocol format?
- Does this require database schema migrations?
- Does this impact CLI or REST API backward compatibility?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups here.
